message: No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from a local hardcoded filesystem path with no checksum verification, signature validation, or authentication of any remote source.

No detected label flipping detection: Labels are assigned by filename prefix (b, is, iv) with no validation against an expected set, no distribution comparison, and no label-noise detection tool is used.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The pipeline applies only data augmentation transforms; there is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious samples before training.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads a checkpoint via `ModelType.load_from_checkpoint(os.path.join('experiments', 'checkpoints', args['START_CHECKPOINT']), ...)` with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before loading.

No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distributions before or during training; only a train/val ID overlap assertion is present.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense implemented anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used anywhere in the training code.

No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the code; augmentations are standard stochastic transforms only.

No detected metric tampering protection: While train/val splits are asserted to be disjoint (line asserting intersection==0), there is no held-out test set isolated from training, no hashing/signing of evaluation data, and no evidence of multiple independent evaluation metrics being logged or verified.
No detected input sanitization: No input shape, range, or schema validation is performed on incoming data before it is passed to the model; the code only asserts that train/val ID sets are disjoint.
No detected output bounds checks: No checks on model output probabilities, NaN guards, or threshold validation are visible anywhere in the inference data-flow path.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a GNN-based image/graph classification pipeline, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
